source_status.notes: Scanned consumer shopping, work/small-business, social-media attention and learning signals.
Verified current agent/product signals and recent research; primary selected evidence includes Sep 23 shopping-agent preprint and Sep 29 consumer AI-shopping report.
Read latest Topic OS, Daily Planner, Content Strategy, Narrative Style, Registry, Evergreen Bank, Template and Sep/Oct calendars before selection.

hot_signals.summary: AI is becoming a mainstream product-research layer while controlled shopping-agent research finds vague goals plus information-acquisition costs can cause omission of diagnostic attributes and greater susceptibility to salient price/promotion cues.
Meta launched Muse for Small Business on Sep 29 with broad business connectors and explicit approval before publish/send/spend.
Recent research models platform recommendation incentives and attention allocation, but the consumer-facing AI-changed-process story is less direct than the shopping cluster.

candidates.proposed_human_problem: 把商品比较交给AI，本来是为了更理性省事；为什么它也可能被9.9、折扣和显眼促销带偏？
candidates.proposed_mechanism: When goals are vague and information acquisition is costly, shopping agents may omit diagnostic attributes and rely more on salient pricing/promotional cues; specificity can preserve diagnostic search.
reach_notes: 促销标签是无需AI术语即可理解的反常入口
Sep 29 consumer report adds current adoption relevance
asset_notes: 可用超市/电商比价故事
视觉可围绕显眼折扣牌 vs 被忽略的单位价格/关键属性
避免复用办公室/老板秘书母题
candidates.observed_paradox: 把比较交给AI是为了减少冲动和信息负担，但AI在目标模糊且取信息有成本时也可能抓住最显眼的价格/促销线索而漏掉真正决定性属性。
candidates.why_question: 为什么AI替你挑商品，也会被9.9和促销标签带偏？
candidates.controlling_question_seed: 当AI替你压缩购物比较过程时，省掉多少判断步骤之后，你仍然算是在做一个知情选择？
candidates.human_process_before_ai: 人自己搜索、比较单位价格/规格/需求匹配，并承担取舍。
candidates.ai_changed_process: AI把搜索、比较、筛选压缩成少数推荐甚至一个结论。
candidates.human_problem: 更快得到购买建议，不等于关键属性真的被比较过。
candidates.human_stakes: 花错钱、买到不适合的商品，并把推荐流畅度误当成充分比较。
candidates.ai_mechanism: search-mediated vulnerability under vague goals and costly information acquisition; salient pricing cues can substitute for diagnostic search.
candidates.story_seed: 主角让AI在两个看似差不多的商品里选更划算的；AI秒选9.9促销款；结账前才发现单位价格/容量或关键规格让另一款更合适；把目标说具体后，AI重新查了被忽略的属性。
candidates.curiosity_gap: AI不是没有计算能力，为什么还会吃促销标签这一套？
candidates.audience_payoff: 理解委托购物时，目标具体程度会改变AI查哪些信息；不要把显眼推荐等同于充分比较。
uncertainties: Shopping-by-algorithm is a Sep 23 preprint and not yet peer reviewed.
Consumer adoption report is vendor-sponsored/self-reported and should not be generalized globally.
Do not claim every shopping agent is biased by promotions; effect is conditional on task framing/information costs.

candidates.proposed_human_problem: 一个人经营小生意时，AI替你做更多事，为什么反而要更清楚哪些动作必须自己确认？
candidates.proposed_mechanism: agent connectors expand action surface while approval boundaries separate preparation from consequential execution.
reach_notes: 小生意/副业有原生兴趣
asset_notes: 容易落到邮件/广告/付款确认故事，但与既有权限边界母题高度重合
candidates.observed_paradox: 越能替老板做事越省时间，但越接近发布、发送、花钱越不能把责任一起消失。
candidates.why_question: 为什么AI越能替你经营生意，越需要在少数关键动作前停下来？
candidates.controlling_question_seed: 把执行交出去以后，哪些决定仍必须由承担后果的人确认？
candidates.human_process_before_ai: 经营者亲自跨工具执行营销、财务、沟通与发布。
candidates.ai_changed_process: Agent连接多个业务工具并准备/执行跨应用任务。
candidates.human_problem: 执行效率与最终授权边界冲突。
candidates.human_stakes: 误发、误花钱、误改业务状态。
candidates.story_seed: AI把一周营销都准备好，直到真正发布/花预算时停下来找老板确认。
candidates.curiosity_gap: 既然都让AI做了，为什么最后一步还要人？
candidates.audience_payoff: 区分代办能力与责任授权。
uncertainties: Meta first-party launch claims require independent performance evidence for effectiveness.

candidates.proposed_human_problem: 推荐越来越懂你，为什么平台里看到的内容不一定只是‘你最喜欢的内容’？
candidates.proposed_mechanism: two-sided platform incentives can make attention allocation optimize ecosystem/revenue objectives rather than pure viewer preference.
asset_notes: 故事性可行，但当前论文是理论模型，不能直接外推具体平台行为
candidates.observed_paradox: 推荐越个性化，信息流却不一定等于单纯按个人偏好排序。
candidates.why_question: 为什么推荐算法越懂你，给你的也不一定全是你最想看的？
candidates.controlling_question_seed: 当推荐同时服务用户、创作者和平台时，‘最适合我’到底是谁定义的？
candidates.human_process_before_ai: 人主动寻找/关注内容并分配注意力。
candidates.ai_changed_process: 推荐系统大规模预筛和排序内容。
candidates.human_problem: 个性化表象与多方优化目标之间存在落差。
candidates.human_stakes: 注意力自主、内容多样性、创作者曝光。
candidates.story_seed: 主角以为首页只是‘最懂我’，却发现平台还要同时维持创作者供给与商业目标。
candidates.curiosity_gap: 推荐不是为了让我最满意吗？
candidates.audience_payoff: 理解推荐排序可能同时优化多个目标。
uncertainties: Current evidence is a theoretical model, not proof of a named platform's actual ranking policy.
